title: Class Odyssey — Noa & Mila, modular wardrobe study
userRequest: prépare moi une démo nickel avec quelques item, habit à tester pour voir si ça marche. tu fais style link zelda mais essaie de de différencier et t'éloigner un peu. personnage style similaire mais pas reprondruire link à l'identique et faire  un version fille

sourceGeometry.copyright: Nintendo — The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
sourceGeometry.method: The source archives publicly linked by the first listing were imported as Collada. This is a local derivative prototype, not a claim of wholly original source anatomy. The second Sketchfab model was inspected but not downloaded.

adaptation.male: Noa: reshaped face, reduced ear tips, amber irises, recolored brows and new short chestnut hair geometry.
adaptation.female: Mila: softer/narrower facial proportions, green irises, recolored brows and new auburn bob geometry.
outfits: Éclaireur: separate fitted teal waistcoat over a cream top
Voyageur: clay-colored jacket, pocket volumes, front placket and rust scarf
accessories: Independently switchable backpack and shoulder straps
adaptation.construction: Plain shirt derived from the source torso, with added volume and thickness. Waistcoat, clothing details, hairstyles and accessories authored in Blender. A dedicated outer-surface fitting mesh prevents clothing penetration.

portraitProvenance: Actual Blender Cycles renders of each default character in the essential outfit, not diffusion images. 1100x1400, transparent background, soft daylight area lights. WebP files are derived from these PNGs.
textureProvenance: Source game albedos from the credited archives, adjusted locally for brightness and new iris/brow/hair-root palettes by prepare_link_textures.py. No generated concept image is used in the final 3D wardrobe.
webExport: Evaluated meshes baked into a relaxed pose. The source rig is retained in the Blender scene; web GLBs and exported looks are static. wardrobe_slot and wardrobe_variant extras drive actual geometry visibility.
